name: KPIT Technologies Ltd
about: KPIT is a global technology company with software solutions that will help mobility leapfrog towards autonomous, clean, smart and connected future. With 13000+ Automobelievers across the globe, specializing in embedded software, AI & Digital solutions, KPIT enables customers accelerate implementation of next generation mobility technologies .

guidance.extracted_by: Extracted at build time by Claude from the transcript text (the same job llm.extract_guidance does with a key), then checked against the next calls and the reported quarterly numbers. Cached per ticker per quarter.

items.quote: we are very confident that what we have talked about, that we will be in a position to maintain 21% EBITDA for the full year.
items.actual_quote: EBITDA growth margin is for the year 20.8%.
items.why: Narrow miss of 20 bps, after being called 'very confident' two quarters before year end.

items.promise: Back to normal (20%+) margins by Q4 FY27
items.quote: when you say you expect to go back to normal levels of margins by 4Q, you indicating that 20% plus EBITDA? Kishor Patil: Yes.
items.actual: 17.8% in Q2; recovery now 'early next year'
items.actual_quote: it will go up to some extent, every quarter, but, it will be early next year when we get there.
items.why: Timeline pushed from Q4 FY27 to early FY28 one quarter after it was given.

items.quote: We expect 30% year-on-year revenue growth in solution and products
items.actual_quote: Products have grown 5% quarter-on-quarter and 25% year-on-year.
items.why: Growing fast but 5 points short of the stated pace.

items.quote: So we expect the EBITDA to be between 22% to 24% from where we are today.
items.actual_quote: our EBITDA has grown from 17.2% to 17.8%
items.why: Due over two to three years, but margin has moved about 3 points further away since it was said.

bull.text: Revenue has compounded 26% a year over 5 years
Profit grew faster than sales (34.1% vs 26% a year), so margins widened
Profits turn into cash: operating cash flow was 173% of PAT over 3 years

bear.text: Margin recovery: promised Back to normal (20%+) margins by Q4 FY27, got 17.8% in Q2; recovery now 'early next year'
EBITDA margin FY26: promised Maintain 21% for the full year, got 20.8% for FY26

claims.summary: The prepared remarks on the latest calls had no whole-company figures to check; management spoke in segment numbers.
claims.note: Each figure management read out on the call is recomputed from the quarterly results the company filed, consolidated and standalone, with EBITDA both before and after other income. A figure is only called a mismatch when the call clearly speaks about the whole company.

checks.title: Profit turns into cash
checks.text: Over the last 3 years operating cash flow was 173% of reported profit, so profit is turning into cash.

checks.title: Customers pay on time
checks.text: Customers now take 61 days to pay, against 64 three years ago.

checks.title: Profit comes from the core business
checks.text: Other income (interest, investment gains, one-offs) was 0% of pre-tax profit in the last 12 months. The core business earns most of the profit.

checks.title: Profit growth backed by operations
checks.text: In FY26, net profit fell 24% while operating profit fell 1%.

checks.title: Tax rate is normal
checks.text: Tax rate in Sep 2026 was 28%, against 27% on average over the four quarters before.

checks.title: No one-off boost this quarter
checks.text: No unusual jump in other income in Sep 2026.

checks.title: Debt under control
checks.text: Debt is 0.21× equity, against 0.12× two years earlier.

checks.title: Promoters are not selling
checks.text: Promoters hold 38.6%, down 0.8 points over the last 4 reported quarters.
